CachedFetch.swift:29 (not a blocker): the discarded fresh-cache decode error is never logged or written to last_error when the network fetch then succeeds. Schema drift that the next fetch fixes leaves no trace. A diagnostic log line would help later debugging.

CachedFetch.swift:104-110 (pre-existing): when the fetch fails and the stale bytes also fail to decode, fallback() throws the decode error instead of AppError.wrapping(the fetch error). The caller sees a schema error rather than the network cause. markFailed has already stored the fetch error, so only the thrown error type is misleading.

LEAK-FAN-007 side effect (behavior, for CORRECTNESS/QUALITY): the prune at NotificationService.swift:155-156 also drops a key when a window is missing from a single snapshot, for example Anthropic seven_day_opus or a scoped limit omitted for one tick. When that window comes back above the threshold, the same threshold notification fires again. Before this change it was suppressed until the value dropped below the minimum. VendorViewModel.swift:266 calls observe on every successful outcome.

RACE-CRO-007 hidden cost (for the performance lens): reset() is called from the main actor via VendorSectionView.swift:571, then OpenAIProvider.swift:158. It now waits on writeGate, which record() holds across load plus AtomicFileWrite file I/O. The block is short (a small JSON file), but it is a new synchronous wait on the UI thread.
